title: The Death of the Little Hen
summary: The little hen choked on a nut kernel on the nut-hill. The rooster ran to the spring for water: the spring demanded silk from the bride; the bride demanded a wreath from the willow...
keywords: the death of the little hen
full_text:
The little hen choked on a nut kernel on the nut-hill. The rooster ran to the spring for water: the spring demanded silk from the bride; the bride demanded a wreath from the willow; the willow demanded bread from the baker.

By the time the water arrived, the little hen had died, a poignant woodland parable of the urgency of timely compassion.
moral: Care for companions with urgency before the brook of help runs dry.
